Question B-001-019-002.

Why the correct answer is right: Single sideband (SSB) requires a means to prevent or indicate overmodulation.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "CW": Continuous wave (CW) is a keyed carrier rather than an SSB speech signal, so this requirement is not aimed at that mode.
- sourceIndex 2: "RTTY": Radioteletype (RTTY) is a keyed data emission, while overmodulation indication or prevention is an SSB voice-chain requirement.
- sourceIndex 3: "FM": Frequency modulation (FM) has its own audio and deviation controls; this requirement is tied to SSB.
